name: Subagent counts and list
summary: See how many subagents each session is running, summed per group and across sessions, and open a read-only list of them.
description: The session listing carries running and total subagent counts, measured by the attention watcher once per cycle and never collapsed from "not measured" or "not applicable" (codex) into zero. In the agents drawer the presentation depends on the row's density: cozy shows a clickable chip beside the status light, detailed shows a plain green count beside the agent icon instead, and every other density shows neither. Since 2026-09-28 (Joe), EVERY density, compact included, also draws a small icon-only marker beside the status light while a subagent is running or a background shell/monitor is parked (replacing the plain square badge issue #1039's follow-up had added): no visible count, its hover title carries the count and the parked reason. The running sessions cell always shows its own chip. Drawer headings and the running sessions header show sums, at every density. Clicking a chip opens a read-only list of the session's subagents: status, type, description and age. A subagent's activity also moves its parent session's last-worked time forward (never backward), so a session whose subagents are busy stays bold and near the top of the drawer and project ordering. The opscenter home dashboard has a SUBAGENTS stat tile (its own tile since the stat strip split, #1157) that shows the total running-subagent count across every live session, summed only from sessions the watcher actually measured, with the number of sessions it covers under it; a session that was never measured, or that cannot run subagents (codex), contributes nothing to that total, and the tile shows nothing rather than a fake zero when no session has been measured yet.

where: Agents drawer, every density: a small icon-only marker beside a session row's status light, drawn while that session has a running subagent or a parked background shell/monitor - hover it for the count and the parked reason.
Agents drawer, cozy density: a green chip beside a session row's status light, drawn only while that session has a positive running-subagent count.
Agents drawer, detailed density: a plain green number beside the row's agent icon instead of the chip.
Agents drawer group and project headings, and the running sessions cell on the home screen: the same chip, summed across the heading's rows.

Opscenter home dashboard, the SUBAGENTS stat tile, last of the six stat tiles: the summed running-subagent count with the number of sessions it covers, once at least one live session has been measured.
how_to: Launch or resume a claude session and let it dispatch one or more subagents (a Task tool call).
Watch the icon-only marker and, at cozy/detailed, the chip appear beside that session's row within one attention-watcher cycle (about 2 seconds) once a subagent starts running.

Hover the marker for the running count and, if a background shell or monitor is parked, the reason; click the cozy chip to open a read-only popup with each subagent's status, type, description and age.
Switch the sidebar density (compact/cozy/detailed) to see the marker alone, the marker plus the chip, or the marker plus the inline count.
Open the opscenter home dashboard and read the SUBAGENTS tile for the summed subagent total across every live session.
examples: A session running three background research agents shows '3 SUB' on its row; clicking it lists each agent's task and how long it has been running.
Two live sessions with 3 and 1 subagents running show 4 on the home dashboard's SUBAGENTS tile, without opening either session.
